Container.Name: Docker-Manager
Container.Overview: Manage Docker containers remotely with a clean web UI, secure login, and per-user permissions.[br][br]Features:[br]- Start, stop, and restart containers from any device[br]- Secure login with admin and user accounts[br]- Per-user container assignments — users only see what you allow[br]- Container groups for quick multi-user assignment[br]- Live container logs viewer[br]- Admin panel for user and group management[br]- Auto-discovers all Docker containers[br]- Mobile-friendly dark UI[br][br]Default login: admin / admin (change after first login!)
